Setting up

What do I need?
An iPhone, a projector connected with a USB-C to HDMI adapter, and a tripod that holds both pointed at a wall. Without a projector, games play on the phone screen by touch, and you can still build games.
The app can’t find the projected area.
Playfield calibrates by projecting markers. Keep the whole picture on a flat, plain wall, make sure the phone’s camera sees all of it, and avoid bright light falling straight on the wall. Then choose Recalibrate. Recalibrate again whenever you move the tripod.
Where is the camera permission?
iPhone Settings › Playfield › Camera. The camera is needed to see hands; it is processed on the phone.

Playing

Do I need an account to play?
No. Every game plays without signing in, and playing sends nothing off your phone. An account is only for the game builder.
My hands aren’t picked up.
Hands are easiest to see in a lit room with the projection landing on them. Stand so your hands are between the projector and the wall, not behind your body, and keep sleeves above the wrist. If nobody’s hands are seen for a while, the game pauses on purpose.
Taps land in the wrong place.
The setup has probably moved since calibration. Choose Recalibrate.

The game builder

How does it work?
Open Create, sign in with Apple, then talk or type what you want to play. The builder is an AI model that writes the game, plays it to check it, and changes it when you ask. Requests go through Playfield’s server to AI providers, so it needs a connection, your sign-in and your permission before it sends anything.
It asks me to “allow” it. What does that mean?
Before the first request, Playfield shows exactly what the builder sends: your requests as text, the game’s code, pictures of the game and art descriptions, and who receives them. The camera is a separate choice you can switch off on that screen. The privacy policy explains it in full.
The builder says it can’t help with a request, or the age check is blocking me.
Every request is checked by a safety filter before the builder sees it; if it blocks yours, rephrase it and try again. The builder is for people 13 and older: it asks Apple’s age check once, and where Apple gives no answer and no law requires one, you can confirm you are 13 or older. You can run the check again in Settings › Safety.
I get an error about providers or “No endpoints found matching your data policy”.
Playfield only uses AI providers that don’t store or train on prompts, and none was free for that request. Try again in a moment, or pick another quality in Settings › Builder config.
It’s slow or stops replying.
The panel shows how long it has waited for the model. If it stays quiet for over a minute, tap Stop and send your message again. Very long chats get slower: use Reset chat, and the builder carries on from the game’s notes. Higher quality and more thinking are slower.
Is the game I made private?
Yes. Games are stored on your phone and are not shared with anyone. The builder sees them only while you are building.

Account and credits

How do I sign in?
With Sign in with Apple, from the builder’s sign-in card or Settings › Account. You can hide your email on Apple’s sheet. If sign-in fails, check your connection and that you are signed in to iCloud on the phone, then try again.
What are credits?
Each account has a monthly allowance for the builder, which resets each month. Settings › Credits shows how much you have used. Higher quality (Settings › Builder config) and more thinking use it faster. When it runs out, the builder waits until the allowance resets; games you already made keep playing. If you need more, email me.
How do I sign out or delete my account?
Settings › Account › Sign out or Delete account. Deleting removes your sign-in details and your Sign in with Apple connection; your games stay on your phone. To also have your usage records and any reports linked to your account deleted, email me with your user ID (tap “Signed in as” in Settings to copy it).

Privacy controls

In the app’s Settings › Privacy you can stop the builder from sending requests to AI providers, allow or block the builder from seeing the camera, and see exactly what it sends. Debug mode (Settings › Debugging) saves play sessions, including camera pictures, on the phone; leave it off unless you are troubleshooting. Details are in the privacy policy.

Report a problem or content

If the builder makes something offensive or harmful, tap the flag on its message or picture, or on the game’s tile on the home screen, and choose a reason. The report reaches me with the content, so I can review it and act. You can also email abdulrreshamwala@gmail.com about this or anything else not working, with what you asked for, what happened and a screenshot if you can. Delete a game from the home screen to remove it from your phone. I read every report and reply as soon as I can.

Please include your iPhone model, iOS version and the Playfield version (Settings › About).
